mapper.select: SELECT ai.id, ai.asset_code, ai.category_id, ai.asset_name, ai.spec, ai.manufacturer, ai.unit, ai.price, ai.status, ai.create_user, ai.create_time, ai.update_time, ac.category_name FROM asset_item ai LEFT JOIN asset_category ac ON ai.category_id = ac.id WHERE ai.id = #{id}
SELECT MAX(asset_code) FROM asset_item WHERE category_id = #{categoryId}
